proposals.evidence: Turner identifies granthi as knot/joint and lists Hindi gā̃ṭh/gā̃ṭhī and Marathi/Gujarati gā̃ṭh. These Dang elbow answers name the joint using that same family; the semantic narrowing is stated explicitly, not confused with the distinct elbow roots kaphōṇi or kūrpara.
